For brands

Put your tools in her hands

Easy Sew Daily reaches 1.12M followers on Instagram — a global audience of beginner sewists who watch closely, save tutorials, and sew along. Her teaching also reaches 182K subscribers on YouTube, where her channel is Sewing With Shamima.

Every post is a short, hands-on tutorial — which makes collaborations simple and honest:

  • Tutorial-first features — your sewing tools or materials used naturally inside a real technique tutorial, the format her audience trusts.
  • Technique series — a run of connected tutorials around one topic, from corners to elastic, building repeat exposure across posts.
  • An audience that acts — her top tutorial alone earned 2.19M likes and 7.7M plays from viewers who sew, not just scroll.
